newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Prime TV raises A$21.09 mln for expansion.
newsitem.headline: Prime TV raises A$21.09 mln for expansion.

text.p: Broadcaster Prime Television Ltd said on Wednesday it had raised A$21.09 million through a placement of 7.4 million shares at A$2.85 a share to fund recent and future expansion.
Prime also said it expected net profit for the year to June 30, 1997 to be at the high end of market expectations of A$15.5 million to A$16.0 million.
The placement, which represented about 8.2 percent of its existing capital base, was fully underwritten by ANZ Securities.

"The placement was strongly supported by major institutions, and there was unfulfilled demand for additional shares," Prime said. Controlling shareholder Paul Ramsay was unable by law to participate in the placement, but his direct interest remained above 40 percent after the placement, the company said.

Prime also said it had taken a strategic position in the New Zealand free-to-air television industry, buying a parcel of 34 UHF broadcasting licences there. The licences were bought from United Christian Broadcasters for about A$3.6 million.
